headline: Reviewed and made changes to senior property tax work-off abatement application; approved prior minutes.
summary: Reviewed a slide presentation for the Tax Classification Hearing before the Select Board that evening. After the open session ended, the meeting moved into executive session to review abatement and exemption applications.
decisions: Approved the October 20, 2026 open session and executive session minutes unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session meeting minutes of October 20, 2026

decision_titles: Minutes of October 20, 2026 open and executive sessions
plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – October 27, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of October 20, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Board reviewed the slide presentation on the Tax Classification Hearing scheduled before the Select
Board that same evening
The Board reviewed and made changes to the Senior Property Tax Work-Off Abatement Application
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
4.         Adjourned Open Session @ 5:40 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:40 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
